name: DR Congo (east)
summary: FRN rebels took Nindja in Kabare on 12 Nov; OCHA counts 323,000 displaced 6–9 Nov; no major city has fallen
state: FRN rebels took the Nindja chiefdom in Kabare territory, South Kivu, on 12 Nov after the army withdrew, opening a route towards Shabunda (Actualite.cd). The army said more than ten civilians were killed in Kalehe between 7 and 12 Nov as it tries to retake positions near Bunyakiri, and OCHA counts over 323,000 people displaced between 6 and 9 Nov (Radio Okapi, 13 Nov). Africanews reported on 10 Nov that fighting is spreading beyond Kalehe. No capture of Goma, Bukavu or Uvira and no direct interstate fighting was found, so Watch holds.
for_you: Civilians in South Kivu face displacement and attacks as front lines move; aid access around Bunyakiri and Walikale is strained. Travellers should follow FCDO advice against all travel to eastern DR Congo.
rubric_hit: Watch: active fighting on several South Kivu fronts; no major city captured and no direct interstate fighting
